Vaibhav Suryavanshi Sets Multiple Cricket Records Before Age 16

Fifteen-year-old cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi has set several new records in T20 matches. He became the first batter to achieve a specific feat before the age of 16, surpassing Nepal's Kushal Malla. Suryavanshi also hit 86 sixes, outperforming Suryakumar Yadav in a calendar year for T20s. He achieved five world records during the Zimbabwe series, including Player of the Match and Series awards at 15. In one series, he scored 394 runs in 5 innings with 39 fours and 28 sixes.
